metadata.title: Klarna’s Shopper Growth Gives Battered Shares a Boost<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Klarna’s Shopper Growth Gives Battered Shares a Boost
Klarna latest quarterly earnings revealed it has continued to win over shoppers, a trend that appeared to draw renewed investor interest on Tuesday.
